# Continental Industry

> > Continental Industry provides industrial solutions and services with a global sales and service network.

Continental Industry is an industrial technology company offering products and services across global markets. The site provides access to their worldwide sales and service locations to support customers internationally.

## Key Topics

- Industrial solutions
- Global sales network
- Service locations
- Customer support
- International presence
- Contact information
- Interactive location finder
- Technical services
- Regional offices
- Global footprint
